parameters.query:
SELECT 
  v.id AS parcel_id,
  v.status,
  v.fecha_programada::text AS fecha_programada,
  v.week_number,
  v.plan_id,
  v.tag_id,
  v.idtag,
  v.origin_panelist_name,
  v.destination_panelist_name,
  v.origin_city_name,
  v.destination_city_name,
  c.name AS carrier_name,
  pr.description AS product_description,
  p_dest.address_line1 AS destination_address_line1,
  p_dest.address_line2 AS destination_address_line2,
  p_dest.postal_code AS destination_postal_code,
  p_dest.address_city AS destination_city,
  p_dest.address_country AS destination_country,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'material_name', mc.name,
      'material_code', mc.code,
      'unit_measure', mc.unit_measure,
      'quantity', pm.quantity
    ) ORDER BY mc.name
  ) FILTER (WHERE mc.id IS NOT NULL) AS materials
FROM v_allocation_details_with_availability v
LEFT JOIN allocation_plans ap ON ap.id = v.plan_id
LEFT JOIN carriers c ON c.id = ap.carrier_id
LEFT JOIN products pr ON pr.id = ap.product_id
LEFT JOIN panelists p_dest ON p_dest.node_id = v.destination_node_id
LEFT JOIN product_materials pm ON pm.product_id = ap.product_id
LEFT JOIN material_catalog mc ON mc.id = pm.material_id
WHERE v.origin_node_id = '{{ $json.node_id }}'
  AND v.fecha_programada <= (DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '6 days')
  AND v.status IN ('pending', 'notified')
GROUP BY 
  v.id, v.status, v.fecha_programada, v.week_number, v.plan_id,
  v.tag_id, v.idtag, v.origin_panelist_name, v.destination_panelist_name,
  v.origin_city_name, v.destination_city_name,
  c.name, pr.description,
  p_dest.address_line1, p_dest.address_line2, p_dest.postal_code,
  p_dest.address_city, p_dest.address_country
ORDER BY v.fecha_programada ASC
LIMIT 10
